records.description: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

description.value: Creates a zone at a location that silences all enemies inside. When the zone expires, all enemies still inside are rooted.

tooltip.value: Soraka creates a starfield that deals {{ totaldamage }} magic damage to champions. The field lingers for {{ rootdelay }} seconds, Silencing enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are Rooted for {{ rootduration }} second(s) and take {{ totaldamage }} magic damage .{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

lore.value: A wanderer from the celestial dimensions beyond Mount Targon, Soraka gave up her immortality to protect the mortal races from their own more violent instincts. She endeavors to spread the virtues of compassion and mercy to everyone she meets—even healing those who would wish harm upon her. And, for all Soraka has seen of this world's struggles, she still believes the people of Runeterra have yet to reach their full potential.
